newsitem.title: USA: NAPM-N.Y. business conditions index 59.5 in July.
newsitem.headline: NAPM-N.Y. business conditions index 59.5 in July.

text.p: The National Association of Purchasing Management (NAPM) index of New York-area business conditions dropped to 59.5 from 64.9 in June.
Manufacturing-sector conditions dropped to 66.1 in July from 74.4 in June, the report said.
The prices paid index was 54 percent in July compared to 55 percent in June, NAPM said.
The New York-area non-manufacturing conditions index also dropped to 58.7 from 63.8 the month before.
An index above 50 denotes growth, NAPM said.
Looking forward to the upcoming six months, purchasers' optimism increased substantially in July, NAPM said.
NAPM's New York business outlook index, which looks ahead about six months, read 73.8 in July, compared to 67.1 in June, the report said.
